build.preparation_manifest_reproduction: Exact match from committed preparation helper.

classification.claim: association is not causal attribution; instrumentation perturbs all reported timings; frequency/run-time differences alone are inconclusive

contract.caveat: association is not causal attribution; instrumentation perturbs all reported timings; frequency/run-time differences alone are inconclusive
contract.classification: four-worker slow calls; association if at least three and >=80% have >=2ms summed runqueue wait or an involuntary switch during absorption
contract.consequence: association selects five physical CPUs for all D2/C2 calls; otherwise retain four; no warm interval or candidate retuning
contract.controls: one uninstrumented same-allocation call per arm/worker; every diagnostic signature must match it

limitations: All 48 instrumented four-worker calls exceed 10.5 ms; only 6 meet the association condition. The fixed rule retains four cores, without showing four is optimal.
Instrumentation perturbs timing materially. Single uninstrumented controls precede the series and cannot identify overhead reliably; do not subtract probe read time.
Sequential procfs snapshots and summed per-thread counters are not a disjoint wall-time decomposition. The negative association result does not rule out scheduler involvement in original variability.
Frequency, scheduling, caches and original easy-four-worker variability remain unresolved. No diagnostic time is scored in D2.
